_comment: One entry per chart tab. `feed` names an adapter in lib/feeds/registry.mjs. `feedParams` is passed verbatim to that adapter. `dp` = display decimals. `tick` = minimum price increment used for level tolerance and volume-profile bucketing. `contract` describes how P&L and sizing are expressed for this instrument (unitsPerLot × priceMove = USD per lot).

symbols.name: Bitcoin / US Dollar
symbols.sourceNote: Binance spot BTCUSDT — real-time klines + aggressor-tagged trades (true delta/CVD). No key required.

symbols.name: Nasdaq 100 E-mini (continuous)
symbols.sourceNote: SIMULATED — there is no free, keyless real-time feed for CME futures. Switch `feed` to `yahoo` (15-min delayed, best-effort) or write a broker adapter in lib/feeds/. The seed price is a placeholder, not a quote.

symbols.name: Gold / US Dollar
symbols.sourceNote: Binance spot PAXGUSDT — PAX Gold, a token redeemable for physical gold, tracks spot XAU within a few dollars. Real-time klines + aggressor-tagged trades. Setups for this symbol are the only ones the executor bridge may forward (the executor is gold-only).

symbols.name: WTI Crude Oil
symbols.sourceNote: SIMULATED — no free, keyless real-time feed for crude futures. Switch `feed` to `yahoo` (CL=F, delayed) or write a broker adapter. The seed price is a placeholder, not a quote.
